QuestInfo.name: The Prince's Request 1
QuestInfo.0: Whatever happened to old #bPrince #p1092003##k, anyway? See what he's up to.
QuestInfo.1: #bPrince #p1092003##k is tired from the long swim to the Nautilus, and he lost all the gifts he brought for #b#p1090000##k. Help the prince by getting his gifts back. Those dastardly #r#o1220002#es#k must have taken all the gifts...
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the #r#o1220002#es#k and retrieved gifts from #bPrince #p1092003##k.

0.0: Thank you... It's such an...embarrassing request...
0.1: While I was weakened, someone took the gifts I had for #b#p1090000##k and threw them in the ocean! I have no idea why someone would think they're garbage... Anyway, I can't meet #b#p1090000##k without those gifts...that would be rude. Could you find them for me?

yes.0: It wasn't too long ago, so they shouldn't have drifted far. You know, the #r#o1220002#es#k I passed on the way here were eyeing my gifts... Maybe the #r#o1220002#es#k took them.

no.0: Well, I can't go looking for them myself, looking like this...

1.0: Ah, you found it! ...It's a little wet, but I guess that's to be expected.

yes.0: I'm glad I came all the way out here now. You've helped make my trip worthwhile.

item.0: I'm sure that the #r#o1220002#es#k have the gifts. They had that look in their eyes.
